verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry or usage tracking is a fair question for an API with SDKs and a CLI, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack covers telemetry, data-retention or usage-tracking opt-out controls. Per-request token counts and rate-limit tiers describe billing visibility, not a privacy opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
